description: Create a quick poll with custom options, vote on it, and watch live percentage bars — votes are saved on this device.

faqs.a: Type a question, add at least two options, and press Create poll. Then click an option to cast votes.
faqs.q: How do I make a poll?

faqs.a: Yes — votes are stored in your browser's localStorage, so they survive page reloads on this device.
Press Reset votes to zero all counts, or New poll to start over.
faqs.q: Can I reset or delete a poll?

faqs.a: Yes — everything, including vote storage, stays in your browser.

howto: Type your poll question and add options (at least two).
Click an option to vote and watch the live results.
title: Poll Maker Lite
